metadata.title: The Cursed Wedding Dress in the Penthouse
metadata.subtitle: His mistress performed a forbidden love-binding ritual in our penthouse—now every mirror shows a weeping bride behind her.

nodes.text: 10:18 PM · Thunderstorm over Skyview Tower. Your smart-home app pings: Smoke sensor triggered in Penthouse 42B while you are away in Boston.
Mrs. Sloane, false alarm on fire—but Miss Serena used a spare keycard to enter 42B. She’s burning red paper in your marble sink.
Tell me she didn’t open the cedar garment trunk in my dressing room.
Too late, darling. Your late aunt’s vintage silk bridal gown fits me way better than it ever fit you. Victor will love the surprise.

nodes.prompt: Serena is performing a forbidden love-binding chant in front of your vanity:

options.label: Warn her why that dress was sealed
options.player_reply_text: My aunt died on her wedding eve after her fiancé betrayed her. Anyone who wears that gown to steal a husband never takes it off.

options.label: Lock down Elevator 42 remotely
options.player_reply_text: Marcus, freeze the penthouse elevator card reader until I land back in town. Keep the hallway cameras rolling.

nodes.text: Nice try! Wait—why did the silk corset laces just pull tight by themselves?! I can barely breathe!
Locked down, ma’am. Oddly, the elevator screen already switched to "OCCUPIED" even though the cab is empty.
10:25 PM · Lightning cracks across the floor-to-ceiling windows. Every mirror in Penthouse 42B fogs over with freezing mist.
Who’s in the closet?! There’s a woman in a veil crying right behind me in the mirror—when I turn around nobody’s there!!

nodes.headline: The Weeping Bride in the Glass
nodes.teaser_text: Next: Serena’s love-binding ashes spell out a warning across the bathroom floor.

nodes.text: 10:38 PM · Serena scrambles out of the bathroom, trailing the heavy crimson-hemmed silk train across the living room.
Victor!! Where are you?! I tried to cut the zipper with kitchen shears and the blades bent sideways!!
I’m stuck in airport traffic, Serena. Wait—why are you inside Sloane’s penthouse tonight?! I told you never to use that keycard!
So you DID give my mistress a spare keycard to my home, Victor. Thanks for confirming that in writing.

nodes.prompt: Serena’s phone camera accidentally triggers a live clip of the bathroom floor:

options.label: Ask about the ashes in the sink
options.player_reply_text: What did the shaman tell you to mix with those ashes, Serena? Victor’s hair?

options.label: Check Marcus’s keycard log
options.player_reply_text: Marcus, pull the building access log for that spare card. How many nights has she been here?

nodes.text: How did you know?! The ashes just floated out of the sink and wrote "THIEF" across the mirror!!
Fourteen entries in the past two months, ma’am. Exporting the certified PDF right now.

nodes.transcript: [panicked, muffled sobbing] "The chandelier is swinging—someone is humming a wedding march from inside the air vents!!"

nodes.headline: Fourteen Secret Nights
nodes.teaser_text: Next: Security sends the keycard evidence—and Victor realizes Serena lied about something huge.

nodes.text: 10:55 PM · Marcus intercepts the spare keycard clone at the lobby scanner and uploads a high-res photo to the chat.

nodes.caption: Ma’am, this isn’t Mr. Victor’s spare card. Someone cloned your personal penthouse pass at a hotel desk.

nodes.text: Hold on—Serena, you told me Sloane left you a spare card for the charity dresses! You CLONED her pass?!
Stop lecturing me and get up here!! The bedroom door just slammed shut and the dress veil draped itself over my face!!

nodes.prompt: Victor begs you to tell him how to break the curse before he reaches the lobby:

options.label: Tell him the aunt’s single condition
options.player_reply_text: My aunt’s gown only releases a trespasser who confesses every lie spoken under this roof.

options.label: Ask about the wine from last Friday
options.player_reply_text: Ask her why you blacked out for nine hours last Friday after one glass of Pinot at the Gala Hotel, Victor.

nodes.text: Serena, whatever you’ve been hiding from me, say it right now before I call the police myself!
Don’t listen to her, Victor!! That hotel photo was real—you promised to divorce her!
If Victor finds out I slipped sleeping drops into his Pinot and staged the hotel photos, I’m ruined.

nodes.headline: The Staged Hotel Night
nodes.teaser_text: Next: Victor freezes in the lobby—because he saw Serena’s unsent confession.

nodes.text: 11:14 PM · Victor bursts into the Skyview lobby, phone shaking in his hand. Above him on Floor 42, every smart-bulb shifts to funeral white.
You DRUGGED my wine last Friday?! Nothing even happened between us—you staged those photos to blackmail me into a divorce?!
I only did it because I love you!! Wait—something icy just grabbed both my ankles under the dress hem!!
Mr. Victor, the penthouse security feed shows Miss Serena being dragged backward toward the cedar trunk—and there is nobody touching her.

nodes.prompt: Victor begs Marcus to override the elevator:

options.label: Tell Victor to stay in the lobby
options.player_reply_text: Wait for the police in the lobby, Victor. My aunt hates unfaithful men almost as much as she hates thieves.

options.label: Ask about the forged divorce draft
options.player_reply_text: Serena, where is the property waiver you tried to slip into Victor’s briefcase this morning?

nodes.text: Sloane, I swear I never touched her! I was stupid to meet her for drinks, I know—I’m calling the police right now.
It’s in my coat pocket by the foyer!! The bridal gown is squeezing my ribs—make your aunt stop!!
[screaming over static] The mirror just cracked in two—and the weeping bride stepped OUT of the glass!!

nodes.headline: Out of the Mirror
nodes.teaser_text: Next: The penthouse hallway camera captures a chilling silhouette outside 42B.

nodes.text: 11:32 PM · Your flight touches down early. As your cab races through the rain toward Skyview Tower, Marcus sends an urgent alert.
Ma’am, the fire stairwell door on Floor 42 is coated in ice. Even the two patrol officers couldn’t pry it open.
My aunt won’t open the door for anyone except family. I’m ten minutes away—keep Serena talking so she doesn’t pass out.
I’ll tell everything!! I paid a shady shaman $12,000 for the love-binding ash AND I hired a hacker to spoof your location logs!

nodes.prompt: Victor stares at the confession in disbelief:

options.label: Ask who helped her clone the card
options.player_reply_text: One more lie, Serena, and I take the scenic route home. Who gave you my hotel room number to clone my keycard?

options.label: Demand the hacker’s chat logs
options.player_reply_text: Forward the payment receipts to the shaman and the hacker straight to Marcus before my cab pulls in.

nodes.text: Victor’s assistant Derek!! He took $5,000 to copy your travel itinerary and hand me your spare badge!
Received, ma’am! Handing the full digital trail directly to the sergeant waiting in the lobby.
11:42 PM · You step out of the cab. The instant your hand touches the lobby elevator panel, the locked cab chimes and glides down.

nodes.headline: The Elevator Answers Only You
nodes.teaser_text: Next: Floor 42’s dark corridor reveals the weeping silhouette waiting at your door.

nodes.text: 11:48 PM · You ride up to Floor 42 with Marcus and two officers. Just before the doors open, Marcus sends the last live frame from the hallway cam.

nodes.caption: Ma’am, look at the end of Corridor 42—the shadow isn’t attacking us. It’s standing guard right over your threshold.

nodes.text: It’s okay, Aunt Mei. I’m home now. You can let the police handle her.
The corset laces just snapped loose!! I’m tearing this dress off right now—take me to jail, I don’t care, just get me out!!

nodes.prompt: As the front door unlocks, Serena sobs on the marble floor beside the folded gown:

options.label: Pick up the heirloom gown gently
options.player_reply_text: Don’t drag my aunt’s silk on the floor. Step back and put your hands behind your back.

options.label: Recover the forged property waiver
options.player_reply_text: Officer, check her beige coat pocket—the forged real-estate waiver is right inside.

nodes.text: The freezing mist lifts instantly. A faint scent of white gardenias lingers where the shadow stood.
Found it, ma’am—along with a vial of sedative drops matching the Friday hotel bar receipt.
Derek just got detained at his apartment too. Sloane, please let me come up—I need to explain everything.

nodes.headline: Scent of White Gardenias
nodes.teaser_text: Next: Victor begs for a second chance—until you show him the one message he forgot to delete.

nodes.text: 12:18 AM · Police escort Serena out in handcuffs. You stand alone in the quiet penthouse as Victor texts from the lobby.
I was a victim too, Sloane! Serena drugged me and tricked me. We can put this nightmare behind us tomorrow.
Really, Victor? Then why did you tell her two weeks ago you were "tired of living in my aunt’s shadow"?
Wait... how do you have that text?! I deleted that thread!

nodes.prompt: You hold the cedar trunk lid open, smelling faint gardenia:

options.label: Tell him Serena backed it up
options.player_reply_text: Your mistress backed up every flirty message onto her cloud drive as leverage. Police just logged it into evidence.

options.label: Invoke the prenuptial infidelity clause
options.player_reply_text: Read Clause 9 of our prenup, Victor. Even emotional collusion forfeits your stake in the Skyview holdings.

nodes.text: I was venting after a bad board meeting! Please, Sloane, don’t end our marriage over a stupid text!
You’re stripping my board seat?! My entire career is tied to Skyview!

nodes.transcript: "Mrs. Sloane, your attorney just arrived in the lobby with the locksmith and the separation notice."

nodes.headline: Changing the Locks
nodes.teaser_text: Next: Before dawn, the board votes on Victor’s future while Serena faces the judge.

nodes.text: 1:45 AM · At the precinct, Serena’s defense lawyer tries to claim she suffered a "stress episode"—until the lab confirms the sedative drops.
Update from the sergeant, ma’am: Bail denied for both Serena and Derek. Felony drugging, burglary, and identity fraud.
Good. Make sure Skyview revokes every access badge issued under Victor’s signature too.
I’m sitting on the park bench outside. I signed the board resignation and the divorce papers. You were always too good for me.

nodes.prompt: You fold your aunt’s crimson-hemmed silk gown back into the cedar trunk:

options.label: Leave the past in the trunk
options.player_reply_text: Sleep well, Aunt Mei. Nobody will ever disrespect this house again.

options.label: Donate the gown to a museum archive
options.player_reply_text: Tomorrow morning I’m donating the gown to the textile museum under Aunt Mei’s full name, so she’s honored properly.

nodes.text: The brass latch clicks shut with a warm chime. Every reflection in the penthouse shines clear and bright.
A single white gardenia petal drifts across the windowsill as the storm clouds part over the skyline.

nodes.headline: Clear Glass at Dawn
nodes.teaser_text: Finale: Morning sunlight bathes the courthouse steps as you reclaim your freedom.

nodes.text: 9:05 AM · Crisp morning sun warms the courthouse steps. Your lawyer hands you the stamped decree restoring 100% of Skyview Holdings to your name.
Penthouse 42B has fresh locks, fresh lilies, and zero ghosts on CCTV. Welcome home, CEO Sloane.
Thank you, Marcus. Put yourself down for a raise—you earned it last night.

nodes.prompt: You slip on your sunglasses and look up at the gleaming Skyview tower:

options.label: Walk straight into the boardroom
options.player_reply_text: Time to chair my first meeting—on my own terms.

options.label: Stop by Aunt Mei’s memorial first
options.player_reply_text: Hold the meeting for thirty minutes—I want to bring white gardenias to Aunt Mei first.

nodes.text: Glass doors glide open to warm applause. No curses, no shadows—only a bright sky ahead.
Morning sunlight catches the dew on the white petals. For the first time in years, the air feels completely free.

nodes.headline: Unbound and Sovereign
nodes.teaser_text: You finished "The Cursed Wedding Dress in the Penthouse"! Explore more supernatural drama.
